question: How many Casual Leaves (CL) is a confirmed employee entitled to in one financial year?
ideal_answer: A confirmed employee is entitled to 4 days of Casual Leave (CL) in one financial year (1 April to 31 March). Employees on probation are entitled to 2 days of Casual Leave.

question: How many working days of Paternity Leave is an eligible employee entitled to for the birth of their first or second child?
ideal_answer: An eligible full-time employee is entitled to 5 working days of Paternity Leave for the birth of the first or second child, which can be used over a span of six months. If medical circumstances require an extension, an additional 3 working days may be granted.

question: Are contractors eligible for paid leave according to the company Leave Policy for Contractors?
ideal_answer: No. Contractors and consultants are not eligible for any paid leave benefits. All leave taken by a contractor is recorded as Loss of Pay (LOP).

question: How many weeks of paid maternity leave is an eligible employee entitled to for the birth of her first or second child?
ideal_answer: An eligible employee is entitled to up to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave for the birth of the first or second child. Up to 8 weeks may be taken before and including the date of delivery with the rest after delivery, or the entire 26 weeks may be taken after the birth.

question: What is the probation period for an employee who joins Matellio with more than two years of prior work experience?
ideal_answer: The probation period is 3 months from the employee's date of joining.

question: What are the standard office working hours, including office start time, flexible reporting time, lunch break duration, and weekly off days?
ideal_answer: The standard office hours are 9:30 am to 7:00 pm (9.5 working hours). The flexible reporting time is from 9:30 am to 10:00 am. Lunch break is from 2:00 pm to 2:30 pm (30 minutes). Weekly off days are Saturday and Sunday.

question: Can final project documents be stored permanently in Microsoft OneDrive? If not, where must they be stored according to company policy?
ideal_answer: No. Microsoft OneDrive must not be used as the permanent repository for team or project files. All finalised project documents must be moved to the designated Microsoft SharePoint Team Site. OneDrive is intended only for drafts, work in progress, personal work files, and temporary storage.

question: How often must passwords be changed for applications that are not integrated with Single Sign-On (SSO)?
ideal_answer: Passwords for applications that are not integrated with Single Sign-On (SSO) must be changed every 90 days. Reuse of the previous password is prohibited. Temporary passwords issued for new accounts must be changed at first login.

question: An employee with three years of prior work experience joins Matellio. What will be the employee's probation period, and which of the following leave types can be used during probation: Casual Leave, Sick Leave, Earned Leave, and Occasional Leave?
ideal_answer: The probation period is 3 months from the date of joining. During probation, the employee may use 2 days of Casual Leave and 2 days of Sick Leave. Earned Leave cannot be used during probation, although it continues to accrue at 1.33 days per month and becomes available after successful completion of probation. Occasional Leave is not available during probation.

question: What happens if an employee's Casual Leave extends beyond two consecutive days?
ideal_answer: If Casual Leave extends beyond two consecutive days, all of those leave days, including the first two days, are treated as Loss of Pay (LOP). They cannot be converted into Earned Leave. Employees are restricted from using more than two leaves in any combination of Casual Leave and Sick Leave.

question: An employee with three years of prior work experience joins Matellio on 5 June and successfully completes probation on 5 September. Can the employee now use the Earned Leave accumulated during probation, and how many Occasional Leaves are added to the employee's leave balance?
ideal_answer: Yes. Earned Leave cannot be used during probation, but it continues to accrue at 1.33 days per month and becomes available for use after successful completion of probation. Two Occasional Leaves are added to the employee's leave balance because more than six months remain in the leave year after successful completion of probation. The probation period is three months for an employee with more than two years of prior work experience.

question: An employee approved for hybrid working wants to save confidential company documents on their personal laptop while working from home. Is this permitted? If not, where should those documents be stored according to company policy, and can the personal laptop be used to access confidential company documents?
ideal_answer: No. Company information must not be stored on personal devices. Company documents must be stored only in approved company storage such as Microsoft OneDrive, Microsoft Teams, or Microsoft SharePoint. Confidential and Restricted information may be accessed only from IT-approved and registered devices. Personal devices may access only Internal information after IT review and approval and must never be used to access Confidential or Restricted information.

question: A Professional and a regular on-roll employee both have unused Earned Leave on 31 March. According to company policy, how many days of Earned Leave can each employee carry forward into the next leave year?
ideal_answer: A regular on-roll employee may carry forward a maximum of 8 days of Earned Leave into the next leave year. Any balance above this limit lapses if not used. A Professional cannot carry forward any Earned Leave. Unused Earned Leave is neither carried forward nor encashed for Professionals.

question: An employee serving the notice period wants to use the remaining Compensatory Off balance. According to company policy, can the employee use the Compensatory Off, what happens to any unused balance, and which leave types may be applied for in the event of a medical emergency during the notice period?
ideal_answer: No. Compensatory Off cannot be used during the notice period regardless of when it was earned. Any unused Compensatory Off balance automatically lapses at the start of the notice period. It cannot be carried forward or encashed, and no additional Compensatory Off can be earned during the notice period. During a medical or personal emergency, the employee may apply only for Earned Leave or Piggy Leave. Casual Leave and Sick Leave cannot be used during the notice period.

question: An employee wants to share a confidential company report with a client by creating an anonymous Microsoft OneDrive sharing link. Is this permitted according to company policy, and what approvals or restrictions apply before sharing confidential information externally?
ideal_answer: No. Anonymous sharing links must not be created. External sharing of confidential information requires written approval from the IT Department and the Chief Operating Officer (COO). Confidential files shared externally must be password-protected. Any approved external sharing must be time-limited and revoked immediately after the business need ends.

question: A permanent remote employee is issued a company laptop. According to company policy, can the employee store confidential company data on the laptop, and what security requirements apply to the device and network connection when working with confidential information remotely?
ideal_answer: Only with written permission. Remote employees are prohibited from storing confidential information while working remotely unless specifically allowed in writing by their manager in consultation with the Head of Department. Confidential information must not be accessed or used in a public or crowded place. The employee must use the company VPN at all times during working hours, and never outside working hours. Confidential company information may be accessed only from IT-approved and registered devices, which must have current operating system patches, antivirus software, and endpoint protection enabled at all times.

question: An employee with three years of prior work experience joins Matellio on 5 June 2025, successfully completes probation, and submits a resignation on 20 December 2025 while serving the full notice period. According to company policy, which leave types can the employee use during the notice period, what happens to the employee's Compensatory Off balance, and is the employee eligible for leave encashment?
ideal_answer: During the notice period, only Earned Leave may be applied for, with approval from the Project Manager, Head of Department, or Management. Employees serving notice are not expected to take planned leave; leave is accommodated in a medical or personal emergency, and Casual Leave and Sick Leave cannot be used. Piggy Leave does not apply, because the Piggy Account covers only employees who joined before 1 April 2023. Any unused Compensatory Off balance automatically lapses at the start of the notice period. It cannot be carried forward or encashed, and no additional Compensatory Off can be earned during the notice period. The employee is not eligible for leave encashment, because the Leave Encashment Policy requires at least one year of completed service at Matellio, excluding the notice period, and no leave is encashed before one year of tenure.

question: A hybrid employee keeps the final version of a confidential client deliverable only in Microsoft OneDrive, shares it with the client through an anonymous Microsoft OneDrive sharing link, and resigns without moving the files to Microsoft SharePoint. For each of these three actions, identify the company rule that has been violated according to company policy.
ideal_answer: Keeping the final client deliverable only in Microsoft OneDrive violates the requirement that OneDrive must not be used as the permanent repository for project files and that finalised documents must be moved to the designated Microsoft SharePoint Team Site. Sharing the document through an anonymous OneDrive link violates the prohibition on anonymous sharing links, the requirement for written approval from the IT Department and the Chief Operating Officer before external sharing, and the requirement to password-protect Confidential information shared externally. Resigning without moving the files to SharePoint violates the employee's responsibility to complete all required handover activities before the final working day and the responsibility to migrate finalised project documents to SharePoint.

question: A permanent remote employee loses a company-issued laptop containing confidential company information. According to company policy, whom must the employee report the incident to and how quickly, what actions will the IT Department take, and can the company recover the cost of the laptop from the employee?
ideal_answer: The employee must report the loss immediately. A lost device must be reported to the IT Department immediately so that a remote wipe or access revocation can be initiated without delay. Because the laptop contains confidential company information, the incident must also be reported immediately to the Chief Operating Officer and the Head of Services Delivery, and the employee must not attempt to investigate it independently. The IT Department will assess and confirm the incident and revoke access if required within one hour, notify the Chief Operating Officer, Head of Services Delivery, and relevant Department Head within two hours, document the incident within twenty-four hours, and complete remediation and a post-incident review within seven business days. The company may recover the total amount of the laptop from the employee; where the loss results from the employee's negligence, misuse, or accident, the cost is recovered at management's discretion.

question: What is Matellio's annual budget allocated for employee benefits and IT security, and how is that budget distributed across different departments?
ideal_answer: The policy corpus does not contain any information about Matellio's annual budget for employee benefits or IT security, nor does it describe how those budgets are distributed across departments. This question cannot be answered from the available policy documents.
